the laminar-specific cortical dynamics of human visual and sensori- motor cortices are in line with a hierarchical organization of the human cortex.

the human cortex is organized in such a manner that it allows for a precise communication within and between cortical areas, which is essential for the efficient processing and integration of information.

distinct anatomical and spectral cortical channels play specialized functional roles in human sensory and motor processing.
